title: The Empty Chair
arc: Low Tide at Alsea Bay (Arc 4, Sunday 2)
source: lore/drift_wood/_SOURCE_BRIEF.md (Sunday page spec · The Empty Chair)
logline: Four silent tiers. The bed under the table, empty.

margin.note: Where the gull goes: a single clean unbroken horizontal stroke.

panels.composition: Tier 1 · The Void Under the Desk. Ground-level wide across the splintered Douglas-fir floorboards of the garage at 3:45 AM — exactly where the dog would have viewed the room. A battered green-enameled swing-arm lamp clamped to the tilted drafting table on the right casts a hard amber cone onto the tabletop and floor; beyond it, cool velvety indigo: banker's boxes, jars of murky brush water, an oil-stained wooden wall. Lower center, half in the light: the braided wool dog bed, worn thin to a crescent, stray white-and-tan hairs in the yarn. Beside it, half under a cinderblock bookcase, a grayed tooth-pitted tennis ball with dried estuary sand. WOOD cropped from mid-torso down on the high stool, feet on the lower rung, left foot hovering inches above where the dog's ribs would have pressed his wool sock. Perfectly still.

characters.pose: cropped mid-torso down on a high draftsman's stool, still, left foot hovering

props: braided wool dog bed, empty, indented

image.prompt: an extreme wide low-angle view across splintered fir floorboards of a garage studio at night from a dog's eye height, a green swing-arm lamp casting a hard amber cone from a drafting table on the right, an empty worn braided dog bed in the pool of light, a grayed tennis ball under a cinderblock shelf, a man's legs on a high stool with one foot hovering, everything else indigo shadow, ink and watercolor in Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw umber, one warm Naples yellow accent

panels.name: The Void Under the Desk

panels.composition: Tier 2 · The Downpour on the Glass. Across the drafting table out the small wood-mullioned casement window facing the gravel alley behind the tavern. Coastal storm at peak: sheets of rain dragged horizontally across the glass; beyond it an illegible bleeding blur of black Sitka spruce crowns whipping in the south wind and sodden green cedar shingles. On the sill: three worn jars — red sable brushes; rusted nibs; a single dried sand dollar. In the dark pane, the faint ghost of Wood's face: dark hollows, three days' stubble, mouth a flat exhausted line, eyes through the glass, not at it.

characters.pose: reflected faintly in the window glass

image.prompt: eye-level across a drafting table to a small wood-mullioned casement window at night in a coastal storm, rain dragged horizontally across the glass in slate and bone-white resist washes, black spruce crowns whipping beyond, three jars on the sill with brushes, nibs and a sand dollar, the faint ghost of an exhausted man's face reflected in the pane, ink and watercolor

panels.name: The Downpour on the Glass

panels.composition: Tier 3 · The Suspended Nib. Wood's right hand poised above the board. Zero crosshatching. Taped to the green vinyl mat with peeling kraft tape: fresh bristol, light blue-pencil four-panel grid, every panel brilliantly blank. The knuckle calloused and stained black. He grips the wooden brush handle, teeth marks near the ferrule. The sable tip fully loaded, a quarter-inch above Panel 1; a single heavy droplet of ink bowed by gravity, refusing to drop. The ink beginning to tack up on the hairs.

characters.pose: right hand only, gripping a brush, motionless

image.prompt: a tight cinematic close-up of a man's ink-stained hand holding a sable brush a quarter-inch above a blank sheet of bristol taped to a green drafting mat, a faint blue-pencil four-panel grid, a single heavy droplet of black ink hanging from the brush tip refusing to fall, razor-sharp clean line, no crosshatching

panels.name: The Suspended Nib

panels.composition: Tier 4 · The Cut. Tier 1's framing exactly, lighting inverted. The lamp switched off. Cold desaturated pre-dawn: neutral tint, raw umber, bruised Payne's gray; the only light a faint bluish glow through the wet window. Wood a heavy slumped silhouette on the stool, head bowed, forearms flat on the angled board, shoulders hitched up around his ears. Below, in gray gloom, the empty indented dog bed.

characters.pose: slumped silhouette on the stool, head bowed, forearms on the board

props: bluish storm light from the window

image.prompt: the same extreme wide low-angle garage studio view but the lamp is off, cold desaturated pre-dawn tones, only a faint bluish storm glow from a wet window, a man's slumped silhouette on a high stool with head bowed and forearms flat on the drafting board, the empty indented dog bed below in gray gloom, ink and watercolor
